vectors.name: synthesized_defaults_v3
vectors.why: Every field this version declares, at its protocol default. Synthesized so the message is held to Apache Kafka's bytes at all; hand-written cases carry the interesting shapes.

vectors.name: owned_partitions_and_a_null_rack
vectors.why: v3 adds a nullable string to a schema that is not flexible, so null is int16 -1 rather than a varint 0, and the nested partition array is a legacy array inside a legacy array.
